name: exists_tensor_dual
summary: S = (dual of the algebra map R[x_{ι×σ}] → ⊗_j R[x_σ], x_{(i,v)} ↦ x_v in the i-th factor) ∘ dualDistrib ∘ tprod.

steps.claim: Take S(l) = (the R-algebra map R[x_{ι×σ}] → ⊗_{j∈ι} R[x_σ] sending x_{(i,v)} to x_v in the i-th factor), dualised, composed with dualDistrib (⊗_j l_j as a linear form on ⊗_j R[x_σ]), as a multilinear map via tprod.
steps.lean:
⟨((aeval fun (i, v) ↦
    singleAlgHom i (X v)).toLinearMap.dualMap ∘ₗ dualDistrib).compMultilinearMap (tprod R)

steps.claim: The identity: the algebra map sends Π_j f_j(x_{(j,·)}) to the pure tensor ⊗_j f_j, on which ⊗_j l_j takes the value Π_j l_j(f_j).
steps.lean:
, by
  simp [aeval_rename, comp_def, ← comp_aeval, -singleAlgHom_apply]; simp [← tprod_prod]⟩
